summary_en: Ramesh called to ask about matte-finish visiting cards, initially requesting an estimate for 100 cards and explaining that he would send the design later. The agent quoted ₹350 for 100 cards, said design approval would be needed, and advised that Vijayawada delivery would take 3 working days. Ramesh provided his name and email, then asked about pricing for 200 cards and wedding invitation cards. The agent could not provide the 200-card price and explained that wedding card pricing depends on design, paper sample, and quantity. Ramesh also asked about advance payment and rush delivery; the agent said orders above ₹1,000 require 50% advance payment and 24-hour delivery costs an additional ₹150. Ramesh then requested that an internal request be submitted for 200 matte-finish cards in Vijayawada and provided his email again. The agent clarified that it could remember the details during the call but could not send the request to the team or promise follow-up. No order was placed, no internal request was confirmed as submitted, and the call ended politely after Ramesh said his questions were answered.
next_action: If follow-up is available, provide the 200-card visiting-card price and clarify whether the requested internal order can be submitted; do not represent it as already submitted.
